plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked mammalian vs avian TRPV1 & seed-survival comparison chart from Tewksbury & Nabhan (26 July 2001, Nature 412: 403–404) and Jordt & Julius (8 February 2002, Cell 108: 421–430) shows 0% seed germination after rodent molar chewing vs high germination after bird gut passage, paired with mammal TRPV1 firing maximally to capsaicin + 43 °C heat while avian TRPV1 fires to >43 °C heat but 0% to capsaicin.

teach_overlay.scale: a wild bird can swallow a habanero or Carolina Reaper pepper as if it were a sweet blueberry — because chili plants engineered capsaicin specifically to lock onto mammal teeth while giving winged seed-couriers a free pass
